summary: This bill requires all immigration enforcement officers to wear and operate body cameras during public-facing immigration enforcement actions and establishes rules for the retention and use of the recorded footage, along with compliance and reporting requirements.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to mandate body camera usage for immigration enforcement officers. While it doesn't change immigration policy itself, it significantly impacts the operations and oversight of immigration enforcement, which is a core aspect of the broader immigration topic. The bill aims to increase transparency and accountability in immigration enforcement actions.
